title: Down into Vicrium
journal: The knight-captain's disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. The lower galleries are shut behind a locked timber door; the gallery-boss, Ah-Zish, keeps the key, and an old adit on the creek bank goes round it through water where crocodiles nest. I'm to get into the lower galleries and find the knights' strongbox. Ah-Zish might give the key to good words or 100 gold, or it can be lifted from him. Smugglers have moved into the lower galleries; I may fight them or sneak past.
objectives: Get into Vicrium's lower galleries, by Ah-Zish's key or the old lower adit. (marker: Ah-Zish, Door to Lower Galleries, Door to Old Lower Adit)
Search the knights' strongbox in the lower galleries. (marker: Knights' Strongbox)

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium, where the knights kept a strongbox in galleries now shut.
plan.next: Go by boat to Seafalls and up the road to Vicrium; get into the lower galleries and find the strongbox.
plan.ways: Ah-Zish's key (persuade him, pay 100 gold or pick his pocket), or the flooded adit past the crocodiles. In the galleries, fight the smugglers or sneak past them.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. The knight-captain tomb at Eurydike needs proof; his disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. I must find it before the Unbound and the Collector.
Get into the lower galleries of Vicrium and search the knights strongbox.
Get the key from Ah-Zish by good words or 100 gold, or lift it from him; take the old lower adit through water with crocodiles; fight or sneak past the smugglers.
I do not know what the Root and the Eye really are, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows. I could ask people and read what I find.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: In the knights' strongbox lay an old parchment map: seven towers standing in the sea, and a crag shaped like a tooth on an island. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the parchment map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a map of seven sea towers and a tooth-shaped crag.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. I got into the lower galleries of Vicrium (the key had to be lifted from Ah-Zish) and found in the knights strongbox an old parchment map showing seven towers standing in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island.
Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go straight there via the marker; I could also study the map first. No other choice is visible.
I do not know what the seven towers or the tooth-shaped crag island are, nor the Root and the Eye. Nesh-Deeka may explain.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Nesh-Deeka already knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and named me Toh-Wo, "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank, with 200 gold. I'm to choose the order's gift: a rapier or a quarterstaff.
objectives: Choose a rapier or a quarterstaff from Nesh-Deeka. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I am a Toh-Wo now. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had not been and would not say how.
terms: Toh-Wo: Nesh-Deeka: "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank

answers: I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She says her officer will read it. She knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium, saying only "we listen". She named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and paid 200 gold.
Choose the orders gift, a rapier or a quarterstaff, from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Take the rapier or the quarterstaff.
I still do not understand how she listens, what the seven towers and tooth crag are, or the Root and the Eye. Her officer or further talk may tell.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passed me to her officer, Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of the same room; from now on I report to her. I'm to show her the map.
objectives: Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

plan.going: I now answer to Never-Writes-Twice, the order's officer.
plan.next: Show her the map, at the back of the room.
terms: Never-Writes-Twice: Nesh-Deeka: her officer, to whom the player now reports

answers: I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passes me to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, whom I now report to.
Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in the same room in Helstrom.
Just talk to her; nothing else is offered.
Still unknown: the seven towers, the tooth crag, the Root and the Eye, how the order listens. Never-Writes-Twice may tell.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Never-Writes-Twice knew the crag on the map: the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle. She told me Cuts-the-Old-Knot was once one of the order, who went mad on sap and killed her minders. She marked the Grey Tooth.

plan.going: The map leads to the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle. Never-Writes-Twice says Cuts-the-Old-Knot was one of the order gone mad on sap.
plan.next: MN11 starts; its first entry marks the Grey Tooth.
terms: the Grey Tooth and Skeith Isle: Never-Writes-Twice: a crag that is the seamark of Skeith Isle

answers: The map shows the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha; Never-Writes-Twice marked it. She warned me off Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member gone mad on sap who killed her minders.
Nothing more is set; the quest is complete. Likely next: Skeith Isle via Archon and Arorha.
Follow the Grey Tooth lead, or return to the Eurydike tomb task.
Unknown: the seven towers, the Root and the Eye, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is now, how the order listens.
